name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.valueAt_coordRetract_sub_mem_hodgeFil
summary: Write y = Σ r_j w_j with w_j ∈ kisinLoc; coordRetract replaces r_j by λ₀(r_j); an S-linear coordinate applied to coefficients preserves membership of such combinations of 𝒦_l-values in hodgeFil(n).

steps.claim: y = Σ_j r_j·w_j with w_j ∈ kisinLoc(L) (span_kisinLoc).
steps.lean: have ⟨_, r, w, e⟩ := mem_span_set'.1 (span_kisinLoc.ge y.2)

steps.claim: valueAt(L, l, μ, coordRetract(L)(y)) − v = Σ_j φ^{−l}λ₀(r_j)·valueAt(L, l, μ, w_j) − v (coordRetract_sum), and sum_map_mem_of_valueField (λ₀ applied to the coefficients of a combination of elements of 𝒦_l lying in hodgeFil(n)) gives the membership; the values of the w_j lie in 𝒦_l (valueAt_mem_valueField).
steps.lean:
by simpa [coordRetract_sum _ e, ← e, S_smul, sub_eq_neg_add] using
                      sum_map_mem_of_valueField k.coord₀ (Option.rec _ _) (·.elim 1 r) (·.rec
    (neg_mem hv) (valueAt_mem_valueField hμ <| w · |>.2))
